summary: dnf5 options: cacheonly, conf_file, disable_excludes, disable_gpg_check, disable_plugin (wins over enable_plugin, needs libdnf5 5.2+), disablerepo, and download-only with a directory.
questions: How do I download packages only with dnf5?
Which wins if a plugin is in both enable_plugin and disable_plugin?
How do I disable a repo for one dnf5 task?

answer_card.title: dnf5 parameters (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `cacheonly`, `conf_file`, `disable_excludes` (`all`/`main`/repoid)
- `disable_gpg_check` (only with present/latest)
- `disable_plugin`: takes precedence over `enable_plugin`; needs python3-libdnf5 5.2.0.0+
- `disablerepo`: per transaction
- `download_only` + `download_dir`
